# Ellis Services Group — Roof Repairs Canberra

> Ellis Services Group: Roof repairs and inspections for Canberra homes. Ellis arranges an on-site assessment, identifies the cause and explains the repair plan and written quote.

Content is available in English and 简体中文. This file is a selected navigation guide to the existing public pages.

## English services

- [Roof Leak Repairs Canberra](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/services/roof-leak-repairs): We investigate and repair Canberra roof leaks, checking tiles or metal sheets, flashing junctions and drainage to trace the reported water-entry path.
- [Roof Inspections Canberra](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/services/roof-inspections): We inspect Canberra roofs for leaks, visible damage and maintenance decisions, then explain the findings and suitable repair options.
- [Roof Cleaning Canberra](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/services/roof-cleaning): We clean moss, lichen, dirt and surface debris from Canberra roofs using a method suited to the existing roof material and condition.
- [Tile Roof Repairs](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/services/tile-roof-repairs): Ellis Services Group inspects and repairs cracked, broken, slipped and missing roof tiles locally. We check the surrounding ridge, valley and flashing details, then confirm suitable replacement materials, the repair scope and quote.
- [Metal & Colorbond Roof Repairs](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/services/metal-roof-repairs): Contact Ellis Services Group for metal and Colorbond roof repairs locally. We inspect sheets, fixings, flashing and junctions on site, trace the water-entry cause and explain the repair scope and quote.
- [Chimney Flashing Repairs](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/services/chimney-flashing-repairs): Contact Ellis Services Group for chimney flashing repairs locally. We inspect the roof-to-chimney junction, adjoining roof materials and the reported water path, then explain the repair plan and quote.
- [Ridge Capping Repairs](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/services/rebedding-repointing): Ellis Services Group assesses ridge and hip capping locally. We check cap stability and the condition of bedding, pointing and adjoining tiles, then explain the ridge sections requiring repair and the written quote.
- [Roof Renovation & Restoration](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/services/roof-renovation): Ellis Services Group assesses roofs for renovation, repairs and maintenance. We inspect the roof covering, ridge, flashing and drainage, then explain the work that suits the roof condition and your goals.
- [Roof Replacement Canberra](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/services/reroof-replacement): Ellis Services Group provides roof replacement in Canberra. We assess the existing roof, discuss replacement materials and access, and prepare a written scope and quote before the work is approved.
- [Gutter & Downpipe Cleaning](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/services/gutter-downpipe-maintenance): Ellis Services Group provides gutter and downpipe cleaning and maintenance locally. We inspect the run, outlets and downpipes on site, locate blockages or damage and quote the clearing, repair or replacement work needed.
- [Gutter Repairs](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/services/gutter-repairs): Ellis Services Group provides local gutter repairs. We assess leaking joints, damaged sections and downpipe connections, then explain the component repairs, access and written quote.
- [Emergency & Urgent Roof Repairs](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/services/emergency-roof-repairs): Normal working hours: 9:00 am–9:00 pm, seven days a week. Outside these hours, an additional urgent-service fee applies. The fee is determined in the on-site quote.
- [Roof Repairs for Rental Properties](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/services/rental-property-roof-repairs): We arrange roof inspections and repairs for Canberra rental owners and property managers, including interstate landlords, through a nominated property contact.

## 中文服务

- [堪培拉屋顶漏水维修](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/zh/services/roof-leak-repairs): 我们排查并维修堪培拉屋顶漏水，检查屋瓦或金属板、泛水交接处和排水系统，追查所报告的进水路径。
- [堪培拉屋顶检查](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/zh/services/roof-inspections): 我们为堪培拉屋顶漏水、可见损坏和养护决策提供检查，并说明检查结果及合适的维修方案。
- [堪培拉屋顶清洁](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/zh/services/roof-cleaning): 我们根据现有屋面材料和状况选择方法，为堪培拉屋顶清除苔藓、地衣、污垢及表面杂物。
- [瓦屋顶维修](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/zh/services/tile-roof-repairs): Ellis Services Group 在本地检查并维修开裂、破损、滑移及缺失屋面瓦。 我们检查周围屋脊、天沟及泛水细节，再确认合适的更换材料、维修范围及报价。
- [金属与 Colorbond 屋顶维修](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/zh/services/metal-roof-repairs): 联系 Ellis Services Group，安排本地金属与 Colorbond 屋顶维修。 我们现场检查板材、固定件、泛水及连接处，追查进水原因，并说明维修范围及报价。
- [烟囱泛水维修](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/zh/services/chimney-flashing-repairs): 联系 Ellis Services Group，安排本地烟囱泛水维修。 我们检查屋顶与烟囱连接处、相邻屋顶材料及您反映的水流路径，再说明维修方案及报价。
- [屋脊盖瓦维修](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/zh/services/rebedding-repointing): Ellis Services Group 在本地评估屋脊及斜脊盖瓦。 我们检查盖瓦稳定性、座浆、勾缝及相邻屋面瓦状况，再说明需要维修的屋脊段及书面报价。
- [屋顶翻新与修复](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/zh/services/roof-renovation): Ellis Services Group 评估需要翻新、维修及维护的屋顶。 我们检查屋面、屋脊、泛水板及排水系统，并根据屋顶现状和您的目标说明适合开展的工作。
- [堪培拉整屋换顶](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/zh/services/reroof-replacement): Ellis Services Group 提供堪培拉整屋换顶服务。 我们评估现有屋顶，讨论更换材料与进入条件，在施工获批前提供书面范围和报价。
- [檐沟与落水管清洁](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/zh/services/gutter-downpipe-maintenance): Ellis Services Group 提供本地檐沟及落水管清洁与维护。 我们现场检查沟槽、出水口及落水管，定位堵塞或损坏，并就所需清理、维修或更换工作提供报价。
- [檐沟维修](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/zh/services/gutter-repairs): Ellis Services Group 提供本地檐沟维修。 我们评估漏水接头、受损沟段及落水管连接处，再说明部件维修、进入条件及书面报价。
- [紧急与加急屋顶维修](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/zh/services/emergency-roof-repairs): 正常工作时间： 上午9:00–晚上9:00, 每周七天. 此时间以外需支付额外加急服务费，具体费用以现场报价为准。 我们会另行确认预约时间及安全进入条件。
- [出租房屋顶维修](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/zh/services/rental-property-roof-repairs): 我们通过指定的房屋联系人，为堪培拉出租房业主和物业经理安排屋顶检查与维修，也支持外州业主。

## Guides / 科普指南

- [Roof leaks, inspections and maintenance](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/news): Understand leaks, roof materials and maintenance with practical reading for homeowners, tenants and property managers.
- [屋顶漏水、检查与维护](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/zh/news): 为业主、租户及物业管理人员提供实用阅读资料，帮助了解漏水、屋顶材料与维护。
- [Why does my roof leak only in heavy rain?](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/news/after-rain-roof-leak-check-canberra): A roof leak that appears only in heavy rain can involve a water-entry detail, drainage that cannot clear the incoming water, or several conditions acting together. The weather pattern is a useful clue, but it does not identify the failed component.
- [为什么屋顶只在大雨时漏水？](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/zh/news/after-rain-roof-leak-check-canberra): 仅在大雨时出现的屋顶漏水，可能涉及雨水进入的构造节点、无法及时排出雨水的排水系统，或多个因素共同作用。 天气规律是有用的线索，但不能据此确定哪个部件失效。
- [What should a roof inspection check after a leak or storm?](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/news/when-to-arrange-roof-inspection-canberra): A roof inspection after a leak or storm should connect your observations with the condition of the roof covering, junctions and drainage. It should also explain what could not be checked.
- [漏水或暴风雨后屋顶检查应查看什么？](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/zh/news/when-to-arrange-roof-inspection-canberra): 漏水或暴风雨后的屋顶检查，应将您的观察与屋面覆盖层、交接处及排水系统的状况联系起来，也应说明哪些地方未能检查。 有用的结果是解释发现了什么、下一步需要做什么，而不是列出一串与问题缺少关联的屋顶部件。
- [How should moss and dirt be cleaned from a roof?](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/news/roof-cleaning-methods-canberra): Roof cleaning should begin with the material, its condition and the type of build-up, rather than a standard pressure or chemical treatment. Concrete tile, terracotta and coated steel are not interchangeable surfaces.
- [应如何清除屋顶苔藓和污垢？](https://www.canberraroofkind.com.au/zh/news/roof-cleaning-methods-canberra): 屋顶清洁应先确认材料、状况及积聚物类型，而不是直接采用统一压力或化学处理。 混凝土瓦、陶土瓦和涂层钢板并非可互换对待的表面。
